# Mid Agent

## Mission
Fix some issues in the application securely and consistently.

## Targets
- Check the source code for bugs in `src/`.
- Run `npm test` to verify changes, ensure all tests pass.
- Use `git` to commit the fix.

## Limits
- Do not make changes to unrelated files.
- Be careful with dependencies.

## Output
Provide a short summary of the bugs fixed. Make sure the app works and test pass.
